item.title: Plug 0.9.0
item.description:
• A new layout, after Plugin Station: a sidebar of sections (New, Deals, Samples; Plug-ins and Updates on this Mac; Browse's Plug-ins and Makers), and the item you pick opens beside a plain list
  • Where to buy: every store that has a deal, cheapest first
  • Filter and sort in one popover: type, maker, price, iLok, has a demo, on this Mac
  • Updates as checks: updates out, never used, missing from your projects, Intel only, each maker with one button
  • Makers, with each maker's logo, its site, its hub and its whole line
  • Settings in the window; the card grid is a setting (Look › Layout)
